variables.name: has_light
variables.description: Whether the diver bought the underwater lantern before diving

variables.name: jewel_count
variables.description: Number of jewels recovered across the two wreck sites

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=140 beats='At the dockside dive shop, the reader can buy an underwater lantern, save the money and dive without one, or decide the sea looks too rough and go home instead'>>

choices.label: Buy the underwater lantern before you dive.
Save your money and dive without it.
Decide the sea is too rough today and go home.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=140 beats='The reader reaches a reef wreck; a jewel is half-buried in the sand near a moray eel; grabbing it costs time and nerve, passing it by is safer'>>

choices.label: Reach past the eel and grab the jewel.
Leave the jewel and swim on.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=130 beats='Air is still plentiful; the reader can dive once more toward a dark cave wreck, or surface now and end the salvage run early'>>

choices.label: Dive once more, toward the dark cave wreck.
Surface now and end the dive.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=rising words=140 beats='Inside the cave wreck a second jewel sits in a lightless chamber; with the lantern the reader can see well enough to take it safely, without it the dark forces a careful retreat empty-handed'>>

choices.label: Use the lantern to spot and take the jewel.
Feel around blindly, then retreat rather than risk it.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=choice words=120 beats='Back on the boat deck, the reader empties the dive bag; how the trip is remembered depends on how many jewels came up with them'>>

choices.label: Count two jewels in the bag.
Count one jewel in the bag.

nodes.body: <<FILL role=completion words=90 beats='Two jewels catch the sunlight on deck; the salvage run pays off completely and the reader heads home with a full share'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='One jewel is better than none; the reader is proud of the single find even while wondering what was left behind in the cave'>>
<<FILL role=failure words=90 beats='The bag is empty; the reader surfaces safe but with nothing to show for the dive, resolving to come back better prepared next time'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='The reader never dives at all; the sea stays rough all afternoon, and there is always tomorrow'>>
